messages:
maria (marketing): Heads up team 10 were finalizing the product launch post for Redwood Optimize. Can we confirm publish time and the lead routing?

alexa (growth): Recommend Wed 9am PT to give partners a heads-up on Tue. Also want a hero CTA to register for the webinar + an early access checklist.

rishi (product): Wed is fine. Final benchmark were citing is 36% lower unit cost and 2.3x median latency improvement vs baseline. Need to include the benchmark methodology link.

taylor (growthops): Routing rules draft for HubSpot: `source=blog_launch -> list: launch_optimize; clicks web CTA -> assign campaign: optimize_launch_2026; webinar signups -> tag: webinar_early`. Also will add `utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_medium=email`.

kate (legal): Quick notes: avoid "best" or absolute claims. Add a short methodology footnote for the benchmark with a link to the eval slate. Confirm that testimonial quotes are approved.

maria (marketing): Got it. I'll swap hero copy to: "Redwood Optimize: faster inference, smaller bills." Working on a 55-char hero quote.

alexa (growth): For email subject line test: A) "Cut inference costs 36% with Redwood Optimize" B) "See how we sped up LLM latency 2.3x" Add `?utm_experiment=subjA` on variant A.

rishi (product): I'm building the landing page and will add the webinar widget. @maria please share the final hero quote and the one-paragraph about the benchmark.

publish-bot: Checklist: missing assets -> `og:image` (1200x630), hero quote (max 70 chars), image alt text, 1 hero testimonial (approved). Run `/schedule publish 2026-04-01T16:00Z` after checklist complete.

taylor (growthops): Also recommend adding the webinar registration to the lead flow: map `webinar_early` -> assign SDR queue: `optimize_launch_sdr`.

kate (legal): I approved the testimonial from Beta Co. Please include consent line "used with permission" and link to legal approval doc.

maria (marketing): Draft hero quote v1: "Optimize inference for faster replies and lower cost." Tightening now. Will add benchmark footnote linking to /benchmarks/optimize-2026.

alexa (growth): Scheduling ops: if publish Wed 09:00 PT, social storm at +15m, +4h, +24h. I'll prep copy once `og:image` is uploaded.

rishi (product): Landing page ready for copy insertion. HubSpot form fields: name, email, company, use-case, consent checkbox.

taylor (growthops): Final QA checklist for Friday: 1) assets uploaded 2) hubspot routing verified 3) subject test configured 4) legal links posted. Please react :thumbsup: if green.

kate (legal): :thumbsup:

alexa (growth): :thumbsup:
taylor (growthops): :thumbsup:
rishi (product): :thumbsup:
maria (marketing): Locking publish Wed 2026-04-01 09:00 PT if no objections. Thanks everyone!
